messages:
Mira Chen: quick q — we're inconsistent across docs and SDK snippets about the 'Dedicated' offering. I see 'Dedicated', 'reserved capacity', and 'reserved' used interchangeably. which term should be canonical in docs and code examples?
Sam Patel: recommend using the product name 'Dedicated' as canonical. first mention can be 'Dedicated (reserved capacity)' for clarity, then just 'Dedicated' after.
Jess Rivera: +1. also billing copy often says 'reserved capacity' — we should keep an alias in the glossary and a short note about billing phrasing.
Mira Chen: I found a few SDK snippets using `reserved_capacity=True` in python and `reserved: boolean` in TS. proposal: rename param to an explicit enum or string, e.g. `deployment_mode=\"dedicated\" | \"hosted\"` so it's clearer than a bool.
Terry Ho: prefer enum/string too. booleans hide intent. e.g. `client.openai.create(model, deployment_mode=\"dedicated\")` vs old `reserved_capacity=True`.
Jess Rivera: agree on enums. migrating will be a friction point — add a migration note for SDK v3. keep a 6-month deprecation shim where `reserved_capacity` still works but logs a deprecation warning.
Mira Chen: working draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4567 — contains updated python/ts snippets. sample change below:
```python
# old
client.generate(\"hello\", reserved_capacity=True)

# new
client.generate(\"hello\", deployment_mode=\"dedicated\")
```
Sam Patel: looks good. also add a short example for the Dedicated billing phrasing: 'Dedicated (reserved capacity) — reserved monthly capacity for predictable throughput'.
Jess Rivera: I'll write the billing sentence. also we need glossary entries for 'model family' vs 'model variant' — i keep seeing both. propose: 'model family' = high-level (e.g., Llama2), 'model variant' = runtime/size/quantization variant (e.g., Llama2-13B-8bit). add both to glossary.
Mira Chen: added a TODO in the PR description to add both.
docs-bot: Auto: created issue #789 in docs backlog for 'glossary: model family vs variant + Dedicated wording' (https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/789).
Terry Ho: action items?
Sam Patel: I'll own the glossary PR. Mira: you can own snippets across /sdk/*; Jess will own billing phrasing + changelog entry. Terry — can you add a small migration note to /docs/migration/sdk-params.md explaining the param rename and deprecation window?
Terry Ho: yes — i'll add the migration note and include a short code diff and a sample deprecation message: \"Deprecated: 'reserved_capacity' will be removed in 6 months. Use 'deployment_mode' instead.\"
Jess Rivera: timeline check: Mira — can you update the SDK snippets by EOD Wed? Sam — can you open the glossary PR by Thurs? I'll review billing phrasing and add changelog entry then.
Mira Chen: yep aiming for EOD Wed. PR 4567 will include a checklist: update snippets, update in-page examples, stub glossary links.
Sam Patel: I'll tag you on the glossary PR for review; also add redirects for old wording in-site so search still finds 'reserved capacity'.
Jess Rivera: small nit — in SDK docs, use snake_case for param examples (python) and camelCase for JS examples, but prefer `deployment_mode` as the canonical name.
Mira Chen: noted. final Q: does anyone object to the enum approach for the public SDK surface?
Terry Ho: no objections. LGTM :thumbsup:
Jess Rivera: no objections. thanks all.
Mira Chen: thanks — i'll push changes and link the PR here once ready. closing thread after merge. /me adds checklist to PR description: [x] snippets, [ ] glossary, [ ] migration note, [ ] changelog
